scoring._comment: Points per stat. Edit to match your league, then rerun the bot to rescore and re-rank everything.

kicking._comment: fg_unknown_distance applies to seasons whose source has no distance breakdown.

defense._points_allowed_comment: Per game: [max points allowed, fantasy points]. First matching tier wins.

coverage_notes: 2026 is in progress; the 2020s lists include games played so far.
Team defense: sacks aren't available before 1980 and count as 0 for earlier seasons.
Team defense: interceptions aren't available before 1940 and count as 0 for earlier seasons.
Team defense: fumble recoveries aren't available before 1980 and count as 0 for earlier seasons.
Team defense: defensive TDs aren't available before 1922 and count as 0 for earlier seasons.
Team defense: return TDs aren't available before 1922 and count as 0 for earlier seasons.
Team defense: safeties aren't available before 1940 and count as 0 for earlier seasons.
Team defense: blocked kicks aren't available before 1999 and count as 0.
Fumbles lost aren't available before 1994 and count as 0 for earlier seasons.
Kickers: attempts (and so misses) aren't known before 1938; those seasons show attempts as unknown and lose no points for misses.
Kickers: field goal distances are known from 1991; earlier field goals score the 'distance unknown' value.
Before 1999, players have season lines only (no game logs).
AFL seasons (1960-69) are included; AAFC seasons (1946-49) are not, matching official NFL records.
The NFL kept few official stats before 1932, so the 1920s lists are short.

sources.pre-1999: Published scrapes of NFL.com and Pro Football Reference (Kaggle: trevyoungquist, josephvm, kendallgillies; GitHub: fantasydatapros, allenjake440; Hugging Face: michaelmallari), FiveThirtyEight game scores (CC BY 4.0), and hand-checked lines from profootballarchives.com, statscrew.com, jt-sw.com and Wikipedia.
